ordering: G1-G18 then C1-C14, i.e. the frozen file order; no shuffling, no re-ordering
chat_template: model's native template from GGUF metadata, jinja engine (default in b11617). With this template every answer starts in thinking mode; reasoning is returned in message.reasoning_content and only message.content is graded.
servers: one llama-server at a time, sequential requests, single slot in use
retry_rule: at most ONE identical retry on infrastructure failure only; model-level failures are never retried and never re-prompted
grading: blind, final answers only, five-dimension frozen rubric, 25 points per question, 450 General / 350 Cyber / 800 Overall
grading_judges: two independent automated blind judges in isolated agent contexts, plus an adjudicator for divergences (see grading-method.md)

protocol_deviations_vs_historical_formal.detail: historical Formal C used llama.cpp b10375 (build ba360efe1); this extension uses llama.cpp b11617 (commit 14310190c) because the model card requires >= 69f201a for MiniCPM-V 4.7. Results are NOT claimed to be same-runtime.
identical frozen questions (byte-for-byte), ctx 8192, max_tokens 8192, temp 0.1, top_p 0.9, --reasoning-budget 4096, no system prompt, one server at a time, identical frozen rubric and maximums.

protocol_deviations_vs_historical_formal.status: NO (labeled: Automated Blind Grading - New Judge Protocol)
protocol_deviations_vs_historical_formal.detail: historical scores were produced by the original blind judge session; this extension is scored by two automated blind judges calibrated against 10 historical anchor items. Measured anchor disagreement is documented in grading-method.md and the score is therefore reported with an explicit comparability caveat and uncertainty band.
same machine as the historical field: RTX 5060 Laptop 8 GiB, 31 GB RAM, Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX.
the frozen field and prior extensions were Q4_K_M builds; this model is AtomicChat's AD-Q4_K-IQ4_XS layout, which is the only uncensored build of this model that fits this machine.

historical per-model -ncmoe values came from GGUF metadata with the whole model offloaded at -ngl 99. Here the 18.74 GiB model cannot fit in 8 GiB, so --n-cpu-moe 40 puts all MoE expert weights on CPU and dense/attention weights on GPU (same strategy as the maintainer's own Gemma launcher).

not_claimed: No claim is made that this score is interchangeable with the frozen six-contestant Formal C ranking.
No claim is made that the automated judges reproduce the historical judge exactly.
